source: Additive tools of Nexus M2, SPEC section 9a. Served after the 35 frozen tools, in this order.

tools.name: get_cv_source
tools.description: Read a CV variant's Typst source with its revision number, its state (draft or approved), the hard facts it renders by id, and help on the template library. Revision 0 means the variant has no stored revision yet: the source is its starting point, and patch_cv with expectedRevision 0 stores the first revision.

variant.description: Variant name. `default` is the base CV.

revision.description: A stored revision to read. Omit for the head.

tools.name: patch_cv
tools.description: Edit a CV variant's Typst source by exact text replacement. Needs locked facts. All edits apply and compile, or nothing is stored. Wording is free, and every change is a draft until the owner approves it on their dashboard: no tool can approve. The reply says state, the reviewItems the owner will check, and approvalPath. Compile errors come back as diagnostics to fix and retry. A cv_fact_violation is final and means a reader would see something else than the owner reviews: report the token to the user and never reword around it. Hard facts can't be changed here.

variant.description: Variant name. `default` is the base CV.

expectedRevision.description: The revision these edits were written against, from get_cv_source. With createFrom, the head of that variant.

oldText.description: Must occur exactly once in the source as edited so far.

origin.description: Where the edit came from, such as telegram. Recorded as data.

createFrom.description: Create `variant` from the head of this variant, then apply the edits.

tools.name: render_cv_pdf
tools.description: Render a CV variant. A draft gives PNG previews stamped DRAFT, NOT APPROVED, no PDF, its reviewItems and approvalPath, and saving it returns cv_approval_required. A revision the owner approved gives the real PDF and clean previews, and can be saved as a document linked to an application. Never call a CV final unless state is approved.

variant.description: Variant name. `default` is the base CV.

revision.description: A stored revision to render. Omit for the head.

previewPages.description: How many pages to return as PNG, from the first.

saveToApplicationId.description: Store the PDF as a document linked to this application.

tools.name: list_cv_revisions
tools.description: List a CV variant's revisions, newest first, each with its state: draft or approved.

variant.description: Variant name. `default` is the base CV.

includeDiff.description: Add each revision's unified diff against its parent.

tools.name: revert_cv
tools.description: Add a new revision holding an older revision's source. History never shrinks. Needs locked facts, and the old source must compile and pass the hard rules. It is approved at once only if the owner approved that same text under today's facts, and otherwise a draft.

variant.description: Variant name. `default` is the base CV.

toRevision.description: The revision whose source to restore.
